structure.note: Two classes: 3,866,254 Class A shares (1 vote each) and 155,634 Class B shares (20 votes each) on May 13, 2025. Jennifer Hyman holds 41.1% of Class B and co-founder Jennifer Fleiss 20.1%. The 10-K says Class B holders 'collectively' control matters put to stockholders, but no single person or entity is shown with more than 50% of votes. Hyman's figures include 6,155 Class B shares held by her spouse and 10,521 RSUs vesting within 60 days.

notes: Fiscal year 2024 ended January 31, 2025 (Rent the Runway's own label; matches data.js fy 'Jan 2025'). Filings: Fiscal 2024 Form 10-K (accession 0001468327-25-000056) and the proxy for the July 8, 2025 annual meeting (accession 0001140361-25-020175), both read on www.sec.gov; share counts reflect the 2024 reverse stock split. A later proxy (September 2025, for a special meeting) was not used. OWNERSHIP BASIS: the proxy's unlabeled 'Total' column is used as the economic percentage. For Hyman (3.6%) and the officer group (8.5%) it matches holdings over all Class A and Class B shares. For the Class A-only holders it repeats the Class A percentage (Bain 10.6%), which is slightly above their share of both classes combined. The figures are recorded as printed and not recomputed. pctVoting is null because no voting-power percentage is stated. The holder filings are old (Bain's 13G is from February 2022), so asOf is null. CASH: no dividends have ever been paid. Financing cash flows were only $2.0 million of short-term financing proceeds and $(2.3) million of other financing payments, with no repurchase line, so buybacks are 0. STOCK COMP: $9.7 million, shown as 0.01 billion after rounding. GEOGRAPHY is null: the 10-K reports no geographic revenue split and says 'We do not currently offer our products and services internationally', so all revenue ($306.2 million) is U.S.
